offering_description.value: Provides skilled nursing, rehabilitation and long-term care for older adults and people recovering from illness or surgery. It operates senior living communities and behavioral health facilities and delivers home health and hospice care through local care teams. It also provides management and accounting services to other healthcare operators.

primary_services.value: skilled nursing and rehabilitation; assisted and independent living; home health and hospice care; inpatient behavioral healthcare; facility management and accounting

customer_segment.value: B2C: Older adults, patients recovering from illness or surgery, hospice patients and people needing inpatient behavioral healthcare; B2B: Third-party healthcare facility operators

end_markets.value: post-acute and long-term care; senior housing; home healthcare; hospice care; behavioral healthcare

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Nursing, rehabilitation, home health, hospice and behavioral healthcare covered by Medicare, Medicaid or private insurers; service fees: Private-pay nursing care, senior living and administrative services for facility operators; rental or leasing: Healthcare properties leased to third-party operators
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses clinical and support staff to care for patients and residents and provides administrative services to facility operators; asset operator: Owns and operates nursing facilities and senior living communities that serve patients and residents

geography_served.value: US regional: Primarily the Southeast and parts of the Midwest, including Tennessee, the Carolinas and Missouri

specialization.value: related lines: Skilled nursing, rehabilitation, senior living, home health, hospice, behavioral healthcare and facility management

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Nursing and rehabilitation centers, senior living communities and behavioral health facilities; other: Hospital discharge planners and physician referrals for post-acute, home health and hospice care

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State licensing for care facilities and agencies, plus CMS certification and participation requirements for Medicare and Medicaid providers

notes: The current state-by-state footprint and scope of ancillary operations are uncertain.
